starters.title: Console program
starters.description: An interactive command-line program: arguments and flags, a prompt, and a command loop that survives a wrong command.

starters.title: HTTP API
starters.description: A hand-written JSON API over SQLite with the parts a real service needs: typed routes, a bearer-token guard, a rate limit, error mapping and a health probe.

starters.title: Todo app with UI
starters.description: A REST API and an admin UI declared in one manifest — a filterable, sortable, paged table with create, edit and delete — sharing one model.

starters.title: Workflow API
starters.description: Business workflows served as endpoints, on the WorkflowApp blueprint: shared steps, a switch, a thrown code rendered as a 422 and a retried payment.

starters.title: Approval flow
starters.description: A human-in-the-loop process: requests approved by a rule or by a reviewer, with a durable wait that survives restarts, a deadline, and a page to submit, approve and reject them.

starters.title: Scheduled job
starters.description: A recurring job fired by a cron schedule and on demand, one run at a time under a lease, with a recorded history and a page to run it and see how the last runs went.

starters.title: Background worker
starters.description: A job queue and the worker that drains it, safe to run as several replicas: a shared lease, retries, failed jobs parked after their attempts, and a page to enqueue and watch.

starters.title: Webhook receiver
starters.description: An inbound webhook endpoint that is safe to redeliver: a shared-secret guard, idempotency claims that survive a restart, and processing off the request path.

starters.title: API sync
starters.description: A local copy of a third-party API: paginated pulls with retries on a schedule, idempotent upserts, cached reads, and a page to sync now and look records up.

starters.title: Report generator
starters.description: A report built from rows: a rollup, two charts and a table laid out as one HTML page with a CSV beside it, kept in blob storage, with a page to build and open reports.

starters.title: MCP server
starters.description: Four tools an assistant can call, over a SQLite table and behind a token — the handlers know nothing about MCP, and one is also served as a REST route.

starters.title: AI agent console
starters.description: A chat in the terminal backed by an agent with two tools, a history that survives restarts, commands, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

starters.title: AI agent service
starters.description: An AI assistant behind an HTTP API, on the AgentApp blueprint: per-conversation history and tools that are plain SQL queries.

starters.title: Semantic search
starters.description: Retrieval-augmented answering over your own documents, with a page to ask, search by meaning and add documents; it declines when nothing is relevant.

starters.title: Reusable HTTP API library
starters.description: A library that exports an Http.Api, configured by its importer and mountable more than once with different settings.

starters.title: Domain repository library
starters.description: A library that owns a table and exports typed create, find, update and delete operations, keeping the connection private.

starters.title: Shared-connection library
starters.description: A backend-neutral library that borrows its importer's database connection, so what it writes joins the importer's transaction.

starters.title: Function library
starters.description: A library of typed functions written in CEL and called from any expression of the application that imports it.

starters.title: Custom resource kinds
starters.description: A library that defines new kinds in YAML alone — one composed from an HTTP request, one that extends it.
